issues.summary: Customs selected container OCLU3488652 (40HC) under HBL MFCIM260011 / MBL OCLU260407 (infusion pumps, HS 9018.90) for physical inspection; it passed and the shipment was released on 2026-03-24.
Customs queried the import licence number declared for the infusion pumps under HBL MFCIM260011 and required the licence to be confirmed before completing the inspection.

decisions.summary: Jiwoo Han will attend the physical inspection of container OCLU3488652 together with Sunwoo Choi on behalf of Meridian Freight.
The consignee (Insoo Hwang) is to send the import licence copy directly to customs to resolve the licence number query.

tasks.summary: Notify the consignee of the inspection and request a copy of the import licence for HBL MFCIM260011.
Send the import licence copy directly to customs to resolve the licence number query.
Attend the physical inspection of container OCLU3488652 with Sunwoo Choi.
Issue the D/O for HBL MFCIM260011 so the infusion pumps can be delivered to Seoul Medica Supplies.
